description: This file defines the CustomShippingQuotesRegion class, which models a custom shipping region with properties such as region name, associated countries, and shipping quote items. It includes methods for setting and getting these properties and a method for serializing the object into JSON format.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuotesRegion
classes.description: A model class representing a custom shipping region with associated country codes, quote items, and a custom region name, also capable of converting itself into a JSON string.

methods.name: setQuoteItems
methods.description: Sets the list of shipping quote weight items.

methods.name: getQuoteItems
methods.description: Returns the list of shipping quote weight items.

methods.name: setCountries
methods.description: Sets the list of country codes for the region.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Returns the list of country codes.

methods.name: setCustomRegionName
methods.description: Sets the custom name for the region.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the object into a JSON-formatted string, including custom region name, countries, and quote items.
